name: Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd. engages in the investment, development, and management of real estate properties in China and internationally. It is also involved in the new home sales agency, digital marketing, existing home brokerage, and channel distribution activities; architectural design business; operation of convention and exhibitions; private equity fund management business; investment in healthcare; and silk business.
